recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-13764; handle FHIR-46202 separately with work-group review if that unresolved later tracker is taken up.
issue_request: FHIR-13764 was a Published/Persuasive MnM STU3 change request asking to correct the primitive code regex because `[^\s]+([\s]?[^\s]+)*` could catastrophically backtrack on values ending in whitespace; the issue noted that `[^\s]+( [^\s]+)*` best matched the prose allowing no leading/trailing whitespace and only single spaces.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 12454, represented in git by 0f9097af2a78da0ef2d92afbbef029ffde9a8a99 (`#13764 - fix code regex`), which changed `source/datatypes.html` and `source/datatypes/primitives.xml` from `[^\s]+([\s]?[^\s]+)*` to `[^\s]+(\s[^\s]+)*`.
additional_context: Later Published/Persuasive code-regex issues FHIR-25413 and FHIR-37406 refined the authoritative and displayed regex to `[^\s]+( [^\s]+)*`; both are already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-46202 is a later Resolved-change-required issue requesting a schema-style `\s` regex, but it is not Applied/Published and appears to revisit the already-published literal-space decision, so it was treated as context only.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current authoritative primitive source already contains `[^\s]+( [^\s]+)*`, the datatype page uses `[%regex code%]`, and the old catastrophic regex no longer appears in active current source.
